name: Test of Faith
summary: At Dorn Plainstalker's camp above Thousand Needles, Horde adventurers face a test of faith. The hermit asks them to step from a wooden plank into the chasm and trust their resolve.

sections.title: A Measure of the Spirit
sections.body: Above Thousand Needles, Dorn Plainstalker reflects on the mind, body, and spirit. He sets trials to measure what lies within an adventurer instead of relying on simple tribal traditions. Conviction takes many forms, he believes. At its heart is faith strong enough to risk one's life.

sections.title: The Leap into the Void
sections.body: On a stone needle, you stand on weathered planks above empty air. To pass, you step into the abyss without a sure promise of survival. Arcane or spiritual forces break your fall and carry you back to safety. Then you are ready for trials yet to come.

faq.answer: Dorn Plainstalker is a tauren hermit at a remote cliffside camp above Thousand Needles. He tests Horde adventurers in faith, endurance, and strength.

faq.q: Will jumping off the plank kill me?
aliases: will fall damage kill me test of faith
faq.answer: No. Though the fall from the needle spire looks fatal, magical warding catches you and teleports you unharmed to Dorn Plainstalker's cave.

faq.q: What happens after passing the Test of Faith?
aliases: what comes after test of faith
faq.answer: Once Dorn judges your spirit receptive, he challenges your physical resilience in the Test of Endurance.

faq.q: Why does Dorn say failure means realizing the vastness of the Nether?
faq.answer: Dorn's words are a grim reminder of mortality. He believes those without the inner fire to commit fully risk losing their lives and souls to the endless void beyond the living world.

faq.q: Can Alliance adventurers take this test?
aliases: is test of faith horde only
can alliance do test of faith
faq.answer: No. Dorn Plainstalker offers wisdom and spiritual guidance only to Horde champions traveling through the dangerous canyons of southern Kalimdor.

faq.q: Where does the Test of Faith take place?
aliases: where is the plank thousand needles
faq.answer: The trial begins at Dorn's camp in the Thousand Needles canyon walls. Magic connects the camp to an isolated stone spire above the gorge floor.

angles.text: For the Shu'halo, rites of passage across Kalimdor's sacred places are an ancient tradition. Dorn's trial asks you to show trust in the unseen.
As a priest, you cultivate faith in higher powers. Dorn's trial asks you to put those convictions into action.
As a member of the Horde, you face trials of conviction, resilience against hostile lands, and unyielding will. These values bind the fledgling Horde together in Kalimdor.
